UI_PROBLEMSTATEMENT_NCR_DIEBOLD_WINCOR_H.text: NCR, Diebold, Wincor, Hyosung, AGS — each ATM OEM produces a different EJ format. There is no industry standard. Banks maintain 5 separate parsers, each breaking on every OEM firmware update.

UI_PROBLEMSTATEMENT_LEGACY_CBS_VENDORS_T.text: Legacy CBS vendors (TCS BaNCS, Nelito) are built for batch processing. Retrofitting agentic AI on a 30-year architecture takes 18–24 months. ASTRA is purpose-built — config change, not a rebuild.

UI_PROBLEMSTATEMENT_INDIA_PROCESSES_609_.text: India processes 609 million cheques annually worth ₹71.1 lakh crore. 2.5 lakh ATMs log every transaction in formats no system can read automatically. Both problems have the same root cause — a missing intelligence layer.

UI_PROBLEMSTATEMENT_THERE_IS_A_MEANINGFU.text: There is a meaningful difference between a model that answers and a system that acts. ASTRA uses the right tier for each task.

UI_OPERATIONSCONFIG_CONTROLS_WHEN_AI_STP.text: Controls when AI STP_CONFIRM decisions auto-file to NGCH. FULL_MANUAL = every cheque goes to human review. SUPERVISED = AI recommends, human confirms. SELECTIVE = AI auto-files low-risk, human reviews the rest. FULL_STP = all STP_CONFIRM decisions auto-file without review.

UI_OPERATIONSCONFIG_FRAUD_PROBABILITY_BE.text: Fraud probability below this score qualifies a cheque for STP_CONFIRM. Only applies when stp_mode is SELECTIVE or FULL_STP.

UI_OPERATIONSCONFIG_FRAUD_PROBABILITY_AB.text: Fraud probability above this score routes the cheque to the ops reviewer queue instead of auto-confirm. Must be lower than STP threshold.

UI_OPERATIONSCONFIG_CONTROLS_HOW_INWARD_.text: Controls how inward cheques are assigned to ops_reviewers. SELF = reviewers manually claim from queue. HYBRID = reviewers can claim manually or system auto-assigns unclaimed items. AUTO = system auto-assigns all using round-robin.

UI_OPERATIONSCONFIG_REDIS_LOCK_DURATION_.text: Redis lock duration for reviewer-claimed instruments. If a reviewer claims an instrument and does not submit a decision within this window, the lock expires and the instrument becomes claimable again.

UI_OPERATIONSCONFIG_RBI_MANDATED_ITEM_EX.text: RBI-mandated Item Expiry Time window. Cheques not decided within this window are deemed approved and must be paid. Default: 180 min (3 hours). Do not lower without verifying operational capacity.

UI_OPERATIONSCONFIG_GOT_OCR2_0_CONFIDENC.text: GOT-OCR2.0 confidence below this threshold routes the cheque to human review for manual MICR / field verification.

UI_OPERATIONSCONFIG_SIAMESE_NETWORK_MATC.text: Siamese network match score below this routes to human review for manual signature comparison. Lower = more human review load; higher = more STP risk.

UI_OPERATIONSCONFIG_CHEQUES_ABOVE_THIS_A.text: Cheques above this amount require dual ops_reviewer approval before NGCH filing, regardless of AI confidence score.

UI_OPERATIONSCONFIG_ACTION_WHEN_SIGNATUR.text: Action when signature or PPS vault has no record for an account. LOCKED to HUMAN_REVIEW by platform constraint (Layer 1) — cannot be changed by any role.

UI_OPERATIONSCONFIG_WHEN_A_DEPOSITOR_S_P.text: When a depositor's payee account is FROZEN at deposit intake: HUMAN_REVIEW routes the instrument to the mismatch queue for an ops reviewer to decide. AUTO_RETURN rejects it at the teller window. FROZEN may be temporary (court order, regulatory hold) — HUMAN_REVIEW is recommended.

UI_OPERATIONSCONFIG_WHEN_THE_PAYEE_ACCOU.text: When the payee account is DORMANT (no transactions for >2 years) at deposit intake. HUMAN_REVIEW gives an ops reviewer a chance to verify reactivation status before returning the cheque. AUTO_RETURN rejects immediately.

When the payee account is classified NPA at deposit intake. NPA is a credit classification — a deposit to that account may still be valid and creditable. HUMAN_REVIEW is strongly recommended; AUTO_RETURN should only be set after explicit compliance officer sign-off.

UI_OPERATIONSCONFIG_ENFORCE_CTS_2010_DPI.text: Enforce CTS-2010 DPI and IQA quality checks on the back (rear) side of the cheque. Default: false — a blank reverse is standard practice and should not cause a compliance failure. Set to true only if your bank stamps or endorses the reverse and wants rear quality enforced.

UI_PLATFORMCONFIG_KUBERNETES_NAMESPACE_F.text: Kubernetes namespace for all CTS workloads. ResourceQuota and LimitRange enforced. EJ lives in a separate namespace — no cross-module traffic permitted.

UI_PLATFORMCONFIG_MINIMUM_NUMBER_OF_WARM.text: Minimum number of warm CTS agent worker pods. KEDA scales up from this baseline on Kafka lag > 10. Never set to 0 — cold start latency would breach IET.

UI_PLATFORMCONFIG_MAXIMUM_CTS_WORKER_POD.text: Maximum CTS worker pods KEDA can scale to. Should match expected peak batch size. 500 pods → 500 parallel cheque agents → entire batch < 600ms p99.

UI_PLATFORMCONFIG_NUMBER_OF_REDIS_NODES_.text: Number of Redis nodes in the CTS cluster (Signature Vault + PPS Vault). 6 = 3 primaries + 3 replicas (3+3 across 2 DCs). Must be ≥ 6 for active-active.

UI_PLATFORMCONFIG_MAXIMUM_MEMORY_PER_CTS.text: Maximum memory per CTS Redis node. Vault warm size depends on number of active accounts. Raise before VaultSyncWorkflow reports evictions.

UI_PLATFORMCONFIG_YSQL_REPLICATION_FACTO.text: YSQL replication factor across YugabyteDB nodes. RF=3 means any 1 node can fail without data loss. Minimum for active-active DC setup. Do not lower.

UI_PLATFORMCONFIG_MAXIMUM_CONNECTIONS_PG.text: Maximum connections pgbouncer-cts pool can hold open. Each CTS worker pod uses up to 10. 500 pods × 10 = 5000 connection requests → pooled to 200 DB connections.

UI_PLATFORMCONFIG_MINIMUM_REPLICAS_THAT_.text: Minimum replicas that must acknowledge before a Kafka write is considered durable. min.insync.replicas=2 with replication-factor=3 means 1 broker can fail without data loss.

UI_PLATFORMCONFIG_MESSAGE_RETENTION_ON_C.text: Message retention on cts.* topics. 48 hours gives a recovery window if the Temporal worker is down during a DC failover. Must be > IET window (3 hours).

UI_PLATFORMCONFIG_NUMBER_OF_TEMPORAL_TAS.text: Number of Temporal task queue partitions for CTS processing. Higher = better parallelism for large batches. Each partition served by dedicated worker threads.

UI_PLATFORMCONFIG_TEMPORAL_NAMESPACE_FOR.text: Temporal namespace for CTS workflows. Isolated from EJ namespace — workflow IDs, history, and schedules do not cross module boundaries.

UI_PLATFORMCONFIG_MINIMUM_TLS_VERSION_FO.text: Minimum TLS version for all inter-service and external connections. Layer 1 — LOCKED by ASTRA platform. Cannot be overridden by any bank configuration.

UI_PLATFORMCONFIG_IMMUDB_CRYPTOGRAPHIC_A.text: Immudb cryptographic audit trail. Layer 1 — always on. Cannot be disabled. Tampering is cryptographically detectable via Merkle tree verification.

UI_PLATFORMCONFIG_ALL_NGCH_PKI_SIGNING_M.text: All NGCH PKI signing must use FIPS 140-2 Level 3 HSM. No software-held private keys permitted. Layer 1 — LOCKED.

UI_PLATFORMCONFIG_IETWATCHDOGWORKFLOW_SP.text: IETWatchdogWorkflow spawned as first child of every ChequeProcessingWorkflow. Fires emergency NGCH filing at T-30s. Layer 1 — LOCKED. Cannot be disabled.

UI_SCANNERSETUPGUIDE_THE_ASTRA_SERVER_CR.text: The ASTRA server creates an 8-character one-time code tied exclusively to this branch. A 24-hour countdown starts immediately. The code appears in large monospace type — easy to read over the phone.

UI_SCANNERSETUPGUIDE_CALL_THE_BRANCH_IT_.text: Call the branch IT coordinator and read the 8-character code aloud (e.g. "SARAS-3X7Q"). Alternatively use your bank's secure internal messaging system. Do not send via plain email or SMS.

UI_SCANNERSETUPGUIDE_THE_INSTALLER_WIZAR.text: The installer wizard shows only two input fields: (1) ASTRA Server URL — same for all branches in your bank, provided by bank IT; (2) Registration Code — the 8-character code you received from Ops Manager.

UI_SCANNERSETUPGUIDE_THE_INSTALLER_CONTA.text: The installer contacts the ASTRA server, submits the code and the PC's machine name, and receives all branch configuration automatically. A green tick confirms a successful exchange.

UI_SCANNERSETUPGUIDE_BRANCH_CONFIG_LOADE.text: Branch config loaded & machine-bound token issued

UI_SCANNERSETUPGUIDE_THE_SERVER_READS_BR.text: The server reads branch details (branch_id, IFSC, endorsement settings, UV scan flags) from YugabyteDB and generates a random API token. The token is stored in cts.scanner_tokens bound to this machine name — it will not authenticate from any other PC.

UI_SCANNERSETUPGUIDE_RESPONSE_INCLUDES_B.text: Response includes: branch_id, bank_id, bank_ifsc, api_url, endorsement_text, enable_imprinter, enable_uv_scan, and the raw API token (shown only once, never stored on the server).

UI_SCANNERSETUPGUIDE_THE_API_TOKEN_IS_SA.text: The API token is saved to token.dat immediately next to config.ini. The installer then calls the Windows AccessControl API to restrict permissions: Read/Write for SYSTEM and Administrators group only. Standard user accounts (including the teller login) cannot read this file.

UI_SCANNERSETUPGUIDE_THE_INSTALLER_REGIS.text: The installer registers ASTRAScannerAgent as a Windows service set to Automatic (start on boot). The service starts immediately. On the Branch Scan Monitor in ASTRA, the branch will show as "Connected" within seconds.
